data.body: Root-cause experiment: live REST read of identical Done query/fields returned 5,276 tickets, 34,960,514 bytes, 53 pages, 33.503 seconds. First 1,000 took 7.047 seconds / 6,777,061 bytes; slowest page 0.971 seconds. Local ACLI 1.3.39 --limit 1000 returned exactly 1,000 in 24.361 seconds; --paginate comparison pending. Existing AcliClient.search_issues eagerly downloads all results with --paginate, then slices locally; fetcher's _DONE_RECENT_CAP=1000 therefore does not bound transport. Proposed remediation: on-demand Jira REST cursor pages using existing REST transport/cursor helper, preserving offset-slice, cache invalidation, field and caller cap contracts. No timeout increase. Will prove bounded reads and failure behavior with regression tests, live probe, make verify, Gerrit gates, and live main workflow.
